title: Footer Nav
description: Footer navigation link list. Neutral-200 text with semibold weight, hover and focus states change to CTA-500 orange.

styles.css: & a{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a:hover{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); text-decoration: none;} & a:active{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); text-decoration: none;} & a:focus-visible{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); outline: 2px solid var(--wp--preset--color--focus-background); outline-offset: 2px;}
